title: varronia selleana
intro: Varronia selleana, commonly known as the Andean wild yam or varronia, is a plant species native to South America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of varronia selleana are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and support immune function, which may also help alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression. The bioactive constituents of varronia selleana include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
